_note: WRAM the renderer owns. Every span here was measured on an EN-combo build produced by tools/build_en_th_full_dialogue.py, with tools/probe_wram.py, by resetting Mesen's access counters once a context was on screen and recording what the game wrote afterwards. Evidence: build/reports/wram.json. Ranges are start-inclusive, end-exclusive.
mirror_note: Below $7E:2000 WRAM is mirrored into banks $00-$3F, so a write through the mirror never names $7E. Rather than prove the mirror quiet, nothing is reserved down there.
